question: The registered office of the Sangeet Natak Akademi is at:
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi is India’s national academy for music, dance, and drama.
 
• It was established by the Indian education ministry in 1952 and is presently an autonomous body of the Ministry of Culture.
 
• The registered office of the Sangeet Natak Akademi is located in New Delhi, India.
 
• It aims to promote and preserve the vast intangible cultural heritage of India through various initiatives and awards.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Awards**

 
 
• These are national honors conferred by the Sangeet Natak Akademi on performing artists and practitioners of traditional arts.
 
• The awards are given annually in the fields of music, dance, and drama.
 
• Awardees receive a cash prize, a shawl, and a citation.
 
 
 
• **Fellowship of the Akademi (Akademi Ratna)**
 
 
• It is the highest honor conferred by the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
 
• The fellowship is awarded to individuals who have made an exceptional contribution to the field of performing arts.
 
• Fellows receive a cash prize, a shawl, and a citation.
 
 
 
• **Training and Scholarships**
 
 
• The Akademi provides scholarships to young artists for advanced training in performing arts.
 
• It also organizes workshops and seminars to promote traditional art forms.
 
• The aim is to preserve and propagate the rich cultural heritage of India.
 
 
 
• **Documentation and Publication**
 
 
• The Akademi undertakes documentation and publication of various art forms.
 
• This includes audio and video recordings, books, and journals.
 
• The aim is to create a repository of the vast intangible cultural heritage of India.
